settingsHint: Receive critical alerts (high project risk, bankruptcy risk, critical ticket) in real time.
emailHint: Critical alerts are also sent to your email address.
thresholdsHint: Above these thresholds, the project manager and management receive a critical alert (notification + email). A "High" level project always triggers an alert.

desktopState.granted: Enabled: alerts show up even when the tab is in the background.
desktopState.denied: Blocked by the browser: allow them in the site settings.
